name: api-gateway token refresh
description: The golden stores auth tokens with a REDACTED signature (prepare_golden.py), so none is a usable credential. At replay time this generator chain re-signs each recorded Authorization bearer with jwt_resign: header and claims (userId, roles, sub) are kept, iat/exp are refreshed, and the token is signed with the replay key the gateway is started with. Non-JWT bearers (e.g. the recorded 'invalid.expired.token' 401 case) are left as recorded. The key is a placeholder rendered by scripts/proxymock/replay-service.sh from PROXYMOCK_JWT_SECRET; never commit a real key here.
